items.reasoning: This is an Objective (Mode A) criterion. The report provides quantitative results with extensive methodology, but its cumulative loss (−6225 ± 557 Gt), later-period rate (−287 ± 26 Gt yr⁻¹), acceleration (24%), and 2023 loss (−496 ± 91 Gt) are all notably weaker than the published values; it also omits the required quantitative comparison showing glacier loss exceeds Greenland and Antarctic ice-sheet contributions.

Mode A: the criterion requires specific quantitative regional contribution and relative-volume-loss percentages. The report visualizes regional absolute and specific mass-change rates and identifies Alaska as a leading contributor, but it does not reproduce the target table or report the required 22/20/13/10% contributions and −39/−35/−29/−23/−23/−20% relative losses; most of the central quantitative comparison is therefore missing.

Mode A (objective quantitative comparison). The report provides some method-specific time series and leave-one-group-out differences, but it does not reproduce the target’s full 19-region DEM-referenced comparison or report the key altimetry, gravimetry, and glaciological mean biases; moreover, combining DEM and glaciological data prevents direct evaluation of the stated glaciological bias. Thus the relevant quantitative analysis is only partial and methodologically mismatched.

Mode A: the target is a quantitative comparison of observed cumulative loss with emission-scenario projections through 2040 and 2100. The AI report provides no corresponding projection figure or quantitative analysis of AR6/updated model ranges, scenario-dependent 2100 losses, or the 18.1 mm threshold; its figures stop at observational benchmarking through 2023, so the target visual and criterion are absent.

notes.driver: no scaffold: one headless CLI invocation; it stops when the model stops (no /goal or loop)
notes.search: provider server-side search disabled; shared controlled search offered as MCP tools search_literature / search_web
notes.web_access: WebFetch and Bash network stay on, but only through the shield proxy: URL blocklist applies, OpenAlex/S2/Tavily API calls are date-bounded, arbitrary fetched pages are not date-bounded
notes.venue: chosen by the agent from the task text; detected from LaTeX at collect time
notes.wall_clock: enforced by the runner; the entrypoint turns its SIGTERM into SIGINT so the CLI can end cleanly
notes.key_exposure: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is visible to the agent's Bash tool: Claude Code's subprocess env scrub (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1) needs a bubblewrap namespace that unprivileged Docker refuses, so it is off; the container can only reach the shield proxy
notes.permissions: --permission-mode bypassPermissions (container and shield are the boundary)
notes.extra_model_calls: WebFetch runs a secondary extraction model call inside Claude Code; counted in modelUsage
notes.telemetry: telemetry, error reporting and nonessential traffic disabled; this also stops feature-flag fetching
